<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="serving-rollout" name="Serving rollout"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="900" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="700" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="Gradual serving rollout: traffic stages" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="760" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="before" value="@champion and a staged
@challenger with a saved
passing comparison
(manual_approval training)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="50" width="200" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="init" value="You create the A/B endpoint
and initialize the rollout:
100% champion, 0% challenger" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="55" width="230" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="evidence" value="Stage evidence
0%: saved comparison and
smoke calls to both versions
above 0%: requests, error rate,
p99 latency, mature labels" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="190" width="200" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="job" value="daily_rollout job
04:00 UTC, paused by
default; at most one
step per run" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="270" y="195" width="190" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="verdict" value="verdict on fresh,
matching evidence" style="rhombus;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="500" y="150" width="200" height="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="advance" value="ADVANCE
PASS after a full stage
(stage_minimum_hours, 24 h):
+traffic_step_percent (10)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="430" width="200" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hold" value="HOLD
too few requests or labels,
stale evidence, short stage:
keep share and stage clock" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="430" width="200" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rollback" value="ROLLBACK (FAIL)
error rate, p99 latency or
quality gate: 0% challenger,
100% champion; rollout ends" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="490" y="430" width="200" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="complete" value="COMPLETE
PASS at 100% after a full stage:
guarded approval rechecks the
saved evidence, then @champion
-> the challenger version" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="425" width="250" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="serving" value="serving_endpoint job
updates the separate delivery
endpoint (production mode,
enabled and follow_champion)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;html=0;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="740" y="610" width="250" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="caption" value="ADVANCE and HOLD wait for the next daily run; a missed day never adds two steps.
ROLLBACK moves traffic only: it does not change a registry alias.
Pausing the schedule stops new decisions but does not move traffic back.
An endpoint update with an unknown outcome holds until it is reconciled.
Final approval refuses promotion if the champion, comparison or approval policy changed." style="text;html=0;fontSize=12;fontColor=#444444;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="1"> g.text: PASS at 100% after a full stage:

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: ADVANCE and HOLD wait for the next daily run; a missed day never adds two steps.
ROLLBACK moves traffic only: it does not change a registry alias.
Pausing the schedule stops new decisions but does not move traffic back.
An endpoint update with an unknown outcome holds until it is reconciled.
Final approval refuses promotion if the champion, comparison or approval policy changed.
